title: Finite Multiset Codes and Affine Lattice Restrictions
summary: We study constant-weight nonnegative integer vectors under half-L1 distance and compare arbitrary codes with full intersections of affine additive-subgroup cosets with the discrete simplex. A heavy-coordinate decomposition gives the exact reduction A_q(n,n-s) = q + B_q(n,s) to codes whose coordinates are bounded by s. It determines the unrestricted optimum throughout 2n > (q+1)s. For every q ≥ 3 and s ≥ 2, at n = qs−1 and D = (q−1)s−1 the unrestricted and full-coset optima are respectively q+1 and q; we classify all q² unrestricted extremizers.
